name: Polish NIP (Tax ID)
description: Polish NIP (Numer Identyfikacji Podatkowej) — the 10-digit tax identification number used by businesses and self-employed individuals in Poland, supported in unhyphenated and official hyphenated formats.
seoTitle: Polish NIP Regex — Validate Polish Tax ID (NIP) Pattern
seoDescription: Regex pattern for validating Polish NIP numbers in raw and hyphenated formats. Generate code for JavaScript, TypeScript (Zod), Go, and PHP with unit tests.
